note: Scripture follows the Bíblia Livre (porbrbsl; ebible mirror por_bpm, USFM). Rows were derived by measurement: a row is `mined` only when the translator claimed Bíblia Livre wording AND the block contains either a quoted span that is a verbatim Bíblia Livre substring or a run of six consecutive Bíblia Livre words. Everything else is `self_rendered` with the translator's reason. `block_index` is work-level (the admin review panel's block split).

Carmichael quotes the KJV and the RV, and hymn or prayer-book lines; where the Bíblia Livre's wording does not carry her point, the line is rendered from the English and marked self_rendered. Jeremiah 49:23 is taken from the Bíblia Livre's two Portuguese fragments only. The meaning-names of the Indian girls (Vitória, Dourada, Tesouro, Duendinha, ...) are translated, as in the es edition. AI-drafted, awaiting native review.

"left all to follow Him" => "deixou tudo para segui-Lo", reshaped from BL "deixaram tudo e o seguiram" (singular, purpose clause as in the English).
"went down into the other water" (allusion, not a quotation) => "desceram à outra água", built on BL "desceram à água".

chorus line "My Strength and my Redeemer, my Refuge—Jesus!" is a hymn/chorus, not the verse; translated by me ("Minha Força e meu Redentor, meu Refúgio—Jesus!"). BL Ps 19:14 has "minha rocha e meu redentor", so BL wording was deliberately not imposed.
